_about: Public-domain Charlotte Elizabeth Tonna (1790-1846), the evangelical writer who published as 'Charlotte Elizabeth', for the Word Hoard: her Personal Recollections (London, 1841), Principalities and Powers in Heavenly Places (1842), Judah's Lion (1843), The Church Visible in All Ages (1845), The Sabbath Question Illustrated (1845) and the American Works with Harriet Beecher Stowe's introduction (1844-46, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Every title page reads 'by Charlotte Elizabeth', her pen name. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
